title: PM docket + sticky notes (day log)
content:
10/07–10/08: running docket + scratch notes (working doc)

Top-level context: prepping small-hosted GA push (tiered rollout w/ canary). fast follow items; lots of sticky threads with eng + SRE. keep this rough.

Today timeline (rough)
- 08:30 Quick sync w/ Aaron (ingest pipeline perf) — agreed to delay canary by 2 hours if perf spikes > 15% over baseline. he will prod infra runbook.
- 09:00 PRD edits pass 1: cleaned acceptance criteria (see notes below) — need product legal call before publishing public-facing bit.
- 10:00 Design review (Mateo) — minor copy tweak for error states; will deliver asset by 11:15.
- 11:30 Go/no-go sync (tentative) with SRE & Eng leads; checklist walk-through.
- 13:00 Post-mtg follow ups: email internal launch list, tag docs.
- 15:30 Stakeholder catch-up: CS + Sales to confirm doc templates; finalize customer comms cadence.
- 17:00 Wrap: roll forward action items, update rollout calendar.

Quick PRD edit notes (lightweight):
- intro: tighten “who this affects” (internal -> external language) — one sentence.
- success metrics: split into quality / cost / latency. add target numbers: p50 < 250ms, p95 < 700ms, token cost < $0.0009/token for default model. (these are guidance, double-check math with Aaron).
- acceptance criteria: add explicit fallback policy: if region latency > threshold for 5m -> fallback to compatible variant; test must be documented in runbook.
- rollout plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 48h with automated rollback on error-rate spike > 3x baseline. log the exact JIRA steps.
- security: mention KMS integration required for Private customers; add checklist item for keys rotation.

Launch checklist (working, do NOT send as final):
- [x] Finalize model config (v1.3-q4)
- [ ] Validate canary in eu-west-1 (Aaron) — blocked by perf test infra (in progress)
- [x] Update public API docs (docs PR merged)
- [ ] Send internal launch notice to CS/Sales (draft in doc, waiting review from Mateo)
- [ ] Run synthetic load test w/ 2x traffic profile (SRE)
- [ ] Confirm billing tags + usage metering (Finance)
- [ ] Legal review for customer-facing SLA blurb (in review)
- [ ] Postmortem template prepared for rollout incidents (SRE)
- [ ] Add alerting for sudden token-cost drift (>20% week over week)

Stakeholder follow-ups (action items):
- Priya: update SDK sample for streaming edge-case — due EOD 10/08 (PR)
- Aaron: perf numbers for small-batch windows + raw traces — due 10/08 14:00
- Erin: ensure runbook includes step for ephemeral KV-cache invalidation; add exact CLI commands — due 10/09
- Mateo: final UI copy for error banner and “retry” UX — send assets 11:15 today
- CS lead (Tess): draft canned responses for customer queries around latency and regional availability — due 10/09

Open questions / blockers (notes to self):
- do we want to advertise quantization as part of GA? pros: lower costs. cons: adds support surface. flag to legal + support.
- telemetry hook: need to capture prompt-template id early in request for regression tracking (is that in runtime today?) — ask infra.
- Jira workflow: which ticket enforces rollback? RED-3421 references, but need an explicit automation step.

Quick numbers (back-of-envelope):
- projected 1st week qps: 1200 avg, peak 3k — requires 2 dedicated instances in eu-west-1 to keep p95 targets (confirm with Aaron)
- estimated token cost impact: ~ +12% on baseline for longer prompts (with caching disabled for canary)

Meeting snippets / one-liners to paste: (keep)
- "Canary window will be extended if perf variance > 12% for two consecutive 5m windows."
- "Fallback must preserve semantic parity; prioritized compatibility over cost in critical regions."

Micro-tasks (quick, do before EOD):
- mark PRD section 'Known Limitations' with emoji flag 
- add link to runbook under 'linked_artifacts' in the doc meta (done)
- nudge legal thread in slack: #legal-aisecurity (ping @mona)
- confirm sample app in GH shows correct env vars (local smoke)
- snapshot today's canary logs and attach to RED-3421

Personal notes (brain dump):
- keep comms short; highlight one measurable change (latency numbers) and one customer-facing improvement (reliability fallback).
- remember to call out specific next steps for Sales (pricing impact summary).
- breathe. coffee. 1 small walk.

If I get time:
- sketch out mini FAQ for CS (3–4 Qs with short answers)
- run through a tabletop with Erin for the rollback scenario

End of scratch notes — will tidy after the 11:30 sync.

References (quick):
- RED-3421 (Jira): add automation step for rollback
- CON-1254 (Confluence): hosted API rollout runbook (link above)
- PR #876: docs update for public API (merged)
